DuoAero 1.3.4 is an A-channel development update based on the original Duolingo 6.103.5 runtime. It is not a finished implementation of all requested features.

The first midterm's path is grouped by major topic, with a chest at the end of each topic and preserved identifiers for previous lessons and chest awards. The native section picker supports the single available midterm. Chest opening now displays a 25-gem confirmation. Formula slots are closer to the equation, incorrect formula feedback uses the native mathematical renderer, and the isothermal pressure example uses e to a power. Word-gap blocks are placed inside their sentences.

Android emulator checks exercised a lesson including an incorrect answer and retry, then reopened the next lesson before and after restarting; they also checked both word gaps, the section picker, formula selections, the chest confirmation with seeded prerequisites and matching-card examples. A sequence of completion-screen frames showed one moving Snoopy after removing a duplicate layer. These checks are not a physical Samsung test or complete traversal of the course. The reported first Atmosphere lesson still requires its specific end-to-end persistence check.

Still incomplete: emotion- and action-specific Snoopy artwork throughout the app, a complete content and large-text/night-mode audit, real Google/Drive sign-in and sync, updater download/install verification, physical sound and vibration, and the matching web interface. Prior intermittent lesson-end responsiveness failures are not fully diagnosed.

`build-info.json` identifies the signing source and `SHA256SUMS.txt` identifies the signed APK. `build-1.3.4` is unsigned signing input and cannot be installed.
